paragraphs: This project is designed as an educational tool to demonstrate the risks and implications of broken access control vulnerabilities, specifically focusing on the unethical use of cookies to gain unauthorized access to web pages. It serves as a practical example for cybersecurity students, ethical hackers, and security professionals to understand how access control misconfigurations can be exploited and, more importantly, how to mitigate such vulnerabilities in real-world applications.

Broken Access Control occurs when a web application does not properly restrict access to its resources from users who are not supposed to access them. This can lead to unauthorized disclosure of information, modification of data, or execution of privileged operations. In this project, we focus on how attackers can exploit cookies to bypass access controls.
